listing.name: SSMSControllerEx - Controller Support
listing.summary: This mod adds full support for using a controller in Starsector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds full controller support for navigating menus, campaigns, and combat.

description:
SSMSControllerEx - Controller support for Starsector

This mod adds full support for using a controller in Starsector. On screens that show UIs with clickable buttons, the mod allows you to either use the joystick to move a fake mouse cursor around the screen to click a button, or use the d-pad to navigate between the clickable elements, then the A button to press a button. Special controls exist to give the player more precise control in the campaign view and the combat view, more details below. Should support about 95% of the screens in the game. Expect hiccups here or there. I have not completed the game. But I've played about 10 hours on my personal Steam Deck using only this mod and I feel rather confident in it at this point. Based off the good work by razuhl with his SSMSController mod Shout out to my fellow couch gamers!

Depends on LunaLib and LazyLib.

Download v2.0.3[0.98a-RC8]

Screenshots:

Spoiler
The on-screen mappings for the title screen
The on-screen mappings in the campaign view
The on-screen mappings in the deployment view
On-screen mappings in combat
The pause menu in combat
The trade UI with bindings visible
The controller settings UI, accessible from the title screen by clicking the "Controller Settings" button

Button mappings:

Spoiler
Generic inputs (Title screen, most UIs and menus and dialog boxes)
Campaign UI (unpaused)
Campaign UI (paused)
Campaign tabs, generic
Trade/Cargo tab inputs
Combat controls (default, steering relative to ship position)
Combat controls (cardinal steering, steering controls are absolute)

Changelog (v2.0.3)

Spoiler
- When you click a stack in the trade UI, the logic that moves the mouse to the opposite cargo doesn't account for scrolling, leading to cases where the mouse ends up above or below the grid and you can only press B to cancel. Now the appropriate cell to be moused over is scrolled into view before moving the mouse.
- Pressing 'X' on any map control now does a right-click, as in "Lay in course"
- Clicking L3 on the Trade UI now sends a right-click, as in "Learn mod/blueprint/etc"

Installation (WINDOWS ONLY)
After unzipping the mod contents to mods\SSMSControllerEx , from the SSMSControllerEx\native\windows folder, copy SSMSControllerExNative.dll to the folder Starsector\starsector-core\native\windows . If your controller worked in the previous version of SSMSControllerEx you shouldn't notice any difference in behavior. This step should ensure that just about any controller with a layout similar to an X-Box controller should work with the mod. To be clear, this is ONLY necessary on windows.

Installation (STEAM DECK ONLY)
After unzipping the mod contents to mods/SSMSControllerEx, replace the jinput.jar under the starsector folder with the one here and replace libjinput-linux64.so under starsector/native/linux with this one the version shipped with Starsector has some bugs with interpreting the buttons/axes from the Steam Deck controller.

Known bugs:

Spoiler
The ship info shows over the menu screen in the combat view
Starsector's LWJGL library that it uses does not work well with the Switch Pro controller and some other controllers like the Steam Deck in Desktop mode. You have to add Starsector as a non-steam game and enable Steam Input for Starsector, this will emulate an XBox controller that works with the game. Not something I can fix unfortunately.

Current controllers supported:
- On Linux and Windows, all controllers supported under the SDL mapping file should be supported by this mod. Big thanks to this team for their great work.

If your controller is unsupported, a special button auto-mapper UI will appear on the title screen prompting you to enter the button corresponding with a given button icon on the screen. Once it's finished, the controller should work. The only caveat is that it doesn't save the mappings, so you'll need to re-enter them every time you start the game.
- there is also the wonderful controller settings UI, see the screenshots, this should be very helpful for setting the active controller, and changing the mappings.[/list][/list]

discordPostHtml:
Full controller support for Starsector. Currently supports Xbox 360, PS4, Nintendo Switch, and Steam Deck. Campaign support is nearly complete for the most common UI's, but for late-game stuff like colony management UI's, don't expect much.

Changelog:

 - Added support for character sheet tab
 - Added support for fleet tab
 - Added support for Refit tab (incredibly basic, mostly just a mouse emulator)
 - Tweaked support for crew/cargo tab so that navigating from it to the adjacent tabs works
 - Added support for map tab (mostly a mouse editor, but it does support toggling sector/system view)
 - Added support for the intel tabs (including support for the main Intel, planets, and faction sub-tabs)
 - Added support for the Command tab (same as Refit currently, just a mouse emulator)
 - On the main campaign view, added support for selecting ship abilities/hotkeys, the current ability is highlighted with a yellow reticle, and you press B to activate the selected ability.
 - Added support for various message boxes that show up throughout the game, for instance the one that shows in campaign view when supplies run low.
 - Tons of small little bugfixes that I can't hope to list

Download: https://github.com/katemonster33/SSMSControllerEx/releases/download/v1.3/SSMSControllerEx.zip
aiDescription: Enables controller input for Starsector using either a virtual mouse cursor or d-pad navigation for UI elements. Provides specialized controls for precise movement in campaign and combat views. Supports most game screens and includes a settings UI for remapping buttons.
